relationship_to_g4_1: Additive G4.2 case-set artifact. The pinned G4.1 contract and its empty NOT_STARTED_G4_2 placeholder remain an immutable snapshot of the G4.1 milestone; this file defines the subsequent case set without rewriting that accepted milestone artifact.

case_limit.comparison_rule: Predeclare the cases; compare them later under the same inputs; retain no-winner and insufficient-evidence outcomes.

asset_sleeves.description: Indian equity research sleeve referenced to Nifty 500 TRI; no security selected or approved.
Government fixed-income research sleeve using the existing rolling gilt-fund proxy convention; not a direct held-to-maturity GoI bond and no security selected or approved.
Gold research sleeve; product, tax category, and execution route remain subject to G5.
Silver research sleeve; product, tax category, and execution route remain subject to G5.
Cash held as a strategic portfolio allocation; a 0% policy weight does not assert that an external or brokerage cash reserve is unnecessary.

initial_deployment.decision_effect: Use one initial deployment for like-for-like asset-allocation comparison. This is a research convention, not an investor-confirmed deployment instruction.

capital_basis.rule: Apply weights to capital later designated for this investment goal after any reserve decision.

contribution_schedule.step_up_allocation_rule: Same sleeve fractions as the case SIP allocation.

rebalancing.rule: At each 12-contribution anniversary in the fixture schedule, rebalance to the case's target weights; between anniversaries, direct new contributions by those target weights.
rebalancing.target_rule: Restore holdings to the case target weights at the stated cadence.
rebalancing.calendar_dates: Relative contribution counts only until actual dates are confirmed.
rebalancing.transaction_cost_and_tax: Not estimated in G4.2; account for them in downstream deterministic and instrument-level work.

distribution_handling.rule: Reinvest net distributions into the sleeve that generated them; do not count pre-tax distributions as reinvested.

cash_and_reserve.decision_effect: Zero strategic cash is a comparison dimension only. It does not set an emergency, brokerage, or off-portfolio reserve to zero.

terminal_measurement_and_exit.decision_effect: Consume the accepted G3 outcome and liquidation semantics when available; no terminal success event or executable exit is defined here.

product_eligibility.dependency: G5 identity, availability, source, fee, tax, and execution checks

execution_precision.research_allocation_precision: Exact decimal fractions; no whole-unit or order-lot rounding is simulated.

zero_return_arithmetic_control.purpose: Reconcile gross mandate initial capital plus scheduled contributions before any separately confirmed reserve when return, tax, fees, and inflation are all zero; this is not deployable portfolio value, a forecast, or performance evidence.

known_limitations: The three cases are allocation hypotheses only; they are not ranked, recommended, optimized, suitability-assessed, or shown to meet either goal.
The zero-return control is arithmetic only and provides no return, risk, tax, fee, or purchasing-power estimate.
Actual terminal outcome and exit remain blocked by G3 and the investor's unresolved measurement date.
No sleeve maps to an eligible security until G5 identity, availability, source, fee, tax, and execution checks pass.
External reserve, actual funding dates, account constraints, and execution rounding remain unresolved or blocked.
invalidation_triggers: A change to the pinned G4.1 input contract or its content fingerprint.

Acceptance or revision of G3 outcome, terminal measurement, or liquidation semantics.

A change to the sleeve definitions, case weights, rebalancing rule, policy limits, or product eligibility evidence.
